title: PermissionRule
description: One rule that outlives a session, as the client sees it (plan 03; plan 28, B-33). `status` is computed at the moment of the answer, because the list shows an expired rule marked and not missing.

scope.description: The scope of a granted rule. `session` is part of the domain's type but every rule reachable from these routes is `project` or `always`: a `session` rule lives in memory only and is never persisted or listed here.

kind.description: The canonical kind the pattern names — `shell`, `file.edit` —, `null` on a disabled rule.

toolName.description: The kind again, or the engine's pattern of a disabled rule — kept beside for the published app, which reads it (plan 28, D-22).

pattern.description: The pattern exactly as written, in the canonical grammar — or, on a disabled rule, the engine's grammar it was written in.

engine.description: The engine the rule is restricted to, or `null` for every engine whose calls have the kind.

grantedBy.description: Who granted it. Always the caller, since nobody sees another person's rules.

reason.description: Why the rule was switched off — a rule written in an engine's grammar that had no unambiguous canonical translation.
